headline: Power Line Protest Erases $3 Billion in Value From AI Infrastructure Firm
summary: Community opposition to transmission poles required for data center power wiped $3 billion in market capitalization from a listed company in a single day, highlighting infrastructure bottlenecks for AI expansion.
why: Expanding artificial intelligence workload requirements demand substantial electrical grid upgrades, creating conflict with local communities and utilities.
why_moved: Investor concerns over project delays and grid interconnection resistance prompted a $3 billion equity sell-off in the affected infrastructure provider.
